unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U18: Distinguish articles,entrenchment and the binding effect of registration

payload.title: Articles organise management within the legal hierarchy
payload.core_explanation_md:
Articles regulate internal management and operate within the Act and memorandum. Relevant model articles can apply under the statutory framework. An article cannot expand the company objects or override mandatory law simply because the members voted for it.

Entrenchment makes alteration of specified articles subject to conditions more restrictive than the usual special-resolution procedure. The source distinguishes formation from later introduction and the private/public consent routes, with notice to the Registrar. Registration binds the company and its members in the described statutory manner; it is not a universal contract granting every outsider an enforceable benefit from every article. Distinguish capacity, internal authority and outsider rights before choosing a remedy.

self_check.prompt_text: Can an article override mandatory law?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The Act and constitutional hierarchy govern.

payload.stem_md: An article purports to permit an activity outside the memorandum objects. Which analysis is correct?

options.text_md: The article always expands capacity automatically
options.explanation_md: Internal rules cannot simply rewrite the memorandum.

options.text_md: Any manager may choose the higher document
Only the article filing date matters
options.explanation_md: Later timing alone does not resolve validity.

options.text_md: Read the article subject to the Act and memorandum

payload.stem_md: An entrenched article is changed using an ordinary alteration route without checking its additional conditions. What was missed?

options.explanation_md: It has no effect on entrenchment.

options.text_md: The more restrictive conditions attached to that article alteration
options.explanation_md: Entrenchment requires the specified additional analysis.

options.text_md: A universal rule that articles can never change
options.explanation_md: Changes are possible through applicable procedures.
It does not determine article alteration.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Entrenchment requires the specified additional analysis.
